LCM of 10 and 15 = 30 units (total work)
P's 1 day work = 30/10 = 3 units, Q's 1 day work = 30/15 = 2 units
One day work of P, Q and R (together) = 30/4 = 7.5 units
R's efficiency = 7.5 − 5 = 2.5 units/day
R alone: 30 / 2.5 = 12 days

Unit digit cycle of 3: 3¹=3, 3²=9, 3³=7, 3⁴=1 (cycle of 4)
4798 ÷ 4 → remainder = 2
So unit digit = unit digit of 3² = 7

When two identical circles pass through each other's centre, the common chord CD and the two centres A, B form an equilateral triangle with side = radius.
CD (common chord) = (√3/2) × side = (√3/2) × AB
8√3 = (√3/2) × AB
AB = 16 cm
So radius = 16 cm

Sum of first 3 subjects = 75 × 3 = 225
Sum of last 3 subjects = 82 × 3 = 246
Sum of all 5 subjects = 225 + 246 − 66 (3rd subject counted twice)
= 225 + 246 − 66 = 405
Average = 405/5 = 81

Let numbers be n−2, n, n+2
(n−2) + n + (n+2) = 126 → 3n = 126 → n = 42
Product of smallest and largest = (n−2)(n+2) = n² − 4 = 42² − 4 = 1764 − 4 = 1760

In ΔABP (P is the foot of the altitude from A to BC, BP = 6):
AB² = BP² + AP² → 9² = 6² + AP² → AP = 3√5 cm
Area of ΔABC = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 3√5 = 18√5 cm²
Circumradius R = (a·b·c) / (4 × Area) = (9×9×12) / (4×18√5) = 27√5/10

Centres of the 3 circles form an equilateral triangle of side 14 cm (2×radius)
Area enclosed = Area of equilateral triangle − 3 × area of 60° sector
= (√3/4) × 14² − 3 × [π(7²)(60°)/360°]
= 49√3 − 77 cm²
Answer = 49√3 − 77 cm²

Let Ayush : Abhishek = 80 : 50 (units)
Abhishek increases by 40% → 50 + 20 = 70
Total original = 130 units; Total after 60% increase = 130 × 1.6 = 208 units
Increase in Abhishek's weight = 70 − 50 = 20 units
Total increase = 208 − 130 = 78 units
Increase in Ayush's weight = 78 − 20 = 58 units
New Ayush weight = 80 + 58 = 138 units
Given 208 units = 104 kg → 1 unit = 0.5 kg
Ayush's new weight = 138 × 0.5 = 69 kg

15³ + 4³ = 19 (15² + 4² − k)
By identity a³+b³ = (a+b)(a²−ab+b²), and a+b = 19
So 19(15² + 4² − 15×4) = 19(15² + 4² − k)
Comparing both sides: k = 15×4 = 60

Initial: Milk : Water = 1 : 4
Water stays constant. New ratio 2 : 1 means for every 1 part water there are 2 parts milk.
Water = 4 parts (constant) → New milk = 2 × 4 = 8 parts
Milk added = 8 − 1 = 7 parts
Initial total mixture = 1 + 4 = 5 parts
% milk added = (7/5) × 100 = 140%

CP = 100, MP = 120 (20% more)
For no loss, minimum SP = CP = 100
Discount = MP − SP = 120 − 100 = 20
Max discount % = (20/120) × 100 = 16.66%

Take total capacity = LCM(36,45,30) = 180 units
A's efficiency = 180/36 = 5, B's efficiency = 180/45 = 4, C's efficiency = 180/30 = 6 (emptying)
(A+B) fill in 7 minutes = (5+4) × 7 = 63 units
Remaining capacity = 180 − 63 = 117 units
Now all three open: net rate = (5+4) − 6 = 3 units/min
Time to fill remaining = 117/3 = 39 min
Total time = 7 + 39 = 46 minutes

Let A's votes = x, B's votes = x − 400
If A had 12.5% less votes, it'd tie with B:
87.5x/100 = (x − 400) + 12.5x/100
112.5x/100 − 87.5x/100 = 400 → 25x/100 = 400 → x = 1600
Total votes cast = x + (x−400) = 1600 + 1200 = 2800
This is 70% of registered voters: Registered voters = 2800 × 100/70 = 4000

sin(C+D) = √3/2 → C+D = 60°
sec(C−D) = 2/√3 → cos(C−D) = √3/2 → C−D = 30°
Solving: C = 45°, D = 15°
Answer = 45 degree and 15 degree

Total Income (Saving + Expenditure, all 5 companies) = 7400
Ratio (Expenditure : Income) = 3500 : 7400 = 35 : 74

= 10000 × (15/100)² = 10000 × 0.0225 = Rs. 225

x³ + 3x² + 3x + 1 = (x + 1)³
Factorising all polynomials and taking the highest powers of each common factor gives LCM = (x+1)³(x+4)(x²+x+1)

Length of direct common tangent = √(D² − (r₁−r₂)²)
24² = D² − (16−6)²
576 = D² − 100
D² = 676 → D = 26 cm

By 12 pm (when Neeraj starts) Vivek has covered 70×4 = 280 km head start
Relative speed = 120 − 70 = 50 km/hr; Time to meet = 280/50 = 5(3/5) hr = 5 hr 36 min after 12 pm → they meet at 5:36 pm — Statement I is correct
Distance by Vivek till 4 pm (8 hrs) = 70×8 = 560 km
Distance by Neeraj till 4 pm (4 hrs) = 120×4 = 480 km
Total = 560+480 = 1040 km, not 1080 km — Statement II is incorrect
So only Statement I is correct → Only I
